GET Execution
NT8
Tradovate
Get execution by ID NT8​

Returns one NinjaTrader execution by ID for the specified account.

Endpoint​

GET /v1/api/accounts/{account}/executions/{executionId}

Headers​
NAME	VALUE
Content-Type	application/json
Authorization	Bearer <token>
Path parameters​
NAME	TYPE	REQUIRED	DESCRIPTION
account	string	Required	Name of account in NT8
executionId	string	Required	ID of the order execution
Code examples​
Python
JavaScript
cURL
import requests



token = 'my-secret-token'



url = "https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/accounts/Sim101/executions/64d62e0891b341419e5986713dec79f4"

headers = {

    "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",

    "Content-Type": "application/json"

}



try:

    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

    print(f"Response Code: {response.status_code}, Response Text: {response.text}")

except Exception as e:

    print(f"An error occurred: {e}")

Success field types​
FIELD	TYPE	DESCRIPTION
success	boolean	Request outcome.
id, orderId, originalOrderId	string	Execution, current order and original order identifiers.
type, instrumentType	string	NinjaTrader execution type and instrument category.
account, serverName, instrument, exchange	string	Account, host, instrument and exchange.
time	string	Execution timestamp as reported by NinjaTrader.
epoch	integer	Unix milliseconds.
name, marketPosition	string	Execution name and position side. The name may be empty.
position, positionStrategy, quantity, barsInProgress	integer	Position quantities, fill quantity and bars-series index.
price, rate, slippage, lotSize	number	Execution price, rate, slippage and lot size.
commission	string	Commission amount serialized as text.
isEntry, isEntryStrategy, isExit, isExitStrategy, isInitialEntry, isLastExit, isSod	boolean	Execution classification flags.
Platform nuances​

The execution fields are returned at the top level, including its orderId, instrument, position side, price, quantity, commission, and entry/exit flags.

WebSocket API​

This request can also be made over the WebSocket API. The account and executionId path parameters are passed inside args.

{

  "action": "rpc",

  "id": "my-request-id",

  "api": "GetExecution",

  "args": {

    "account": "Sim101",

    "executionId": "exec_a1b2c3"

  }

}
